plan.summary: By the end you will see how a network of tiny decision-makers learns from its mistakes, stores meaning as positions, and picks the next word.

lessons.title: When a neuron fires
lessons.goal: Explain how a neuron turns weighted inputs into a yes or no.
lessons.aha: A neuron is a weighted vote with a threshold; weights and bias decide when it tips.
lessons.visual: graph2d sigmoid with draggable input, bias and weight knobs

lessons.title: Walking downhill to learn
lessons.goal: Explain how a model learns by stepping downhill on its error.
lessons.aha: Learning is repeatedly nudging weights in the direction that lowers the error.
lessons.visual: graph2d loss curve with draggable weight, slope and step size

lessons.title: Words as places on a map
lessons.aha: Meaning becomes position: similar words sit close, and directions carry meaning.
lessons.visual: graph2d map of words with a draggable new word

lessons.title: How a chatbot picks the next word
lessons.aha: A chatbot scores every word and rolls weighted dice; temperature reshapes the odds.
lessons.visual: bar chart of next-word odds with a temperature knob

steps.say: A neuron adds up its input and decides how strongly to fire.

task.hint: Drag the orange dot until it fires above 90%.

steps.after: Weak input: almost silent. Strong input: fires. In between, it tips.

steps.say: The bias decides where the tipping point sits.

task.question: Raise the bias and the neuron fires…

steps.after: The whole curve slid left: it now fires with less input.

steps.say: Weight decides how sharp the switch is. Make it nearly a hard on/off switch.
steps.after: Big weight: a sudden flip. Small weight: a gentle ramp.

steps.say: Learning a network means tuning millions of weights and biases like these.
A model learns by lowering its error. The blue dot is where it stands now.

task.hint: Drag the dot to the lowest error.

steps.after: You found the bottom by looking. A model can't see the whole curve.

steps.say: Here's all it can feel: the slope under its feet.

task.question: The slope here tilts down to the right. So it should step…

steps.after: Downhill is right. The green dot is where one step lands.

steps.say: Make the step so big that it jumps clean over the bottom.
steps.after: Too big a step overshoots, and learning bounces around.

steps.say: Gradient descent: feel the slope, take a modest step downhill, repeat.

lessons.title: Words as places on a map

steps.say: An AI stores each word as a point. Words with similar meanings sit close together.
steps.after: Banana is apple's neighbour: the AI learned they're used alike.

steps.say: Drag "mango" to where you think it belongs.

task.hint: Drag the red dot near the other fruit.

steps.after: Among the fruit. That's how an AI would place it after reading about mangoes.

steps.say: The orange arrows from man→woman and king→queen point the same way.

task.question: So king − man + woman lands near…

steps.after: Directions carry meaning too. That's why word maths works.

steps.say: Embeddings turn meaning into position, so "similar" becomes "nearby".

lessons.title: How a chatbot picks the next word

steps.say: A chatbot never knows the next word. It scores every word, then rolls weighted dice.

task.hint: Tap the word it's most likely to pick.

steps.after: Most likely, but not certain: sometimes it picks something else.

steps.say: Temperature reshapes the odds. Turn it right down.
steps.after: Cold: the top word takes almost everything. Safe and repetitive.
Odds flatten out: odd words get a real chance. Creative, sometimes nonsense.

steps.say: Temperature trades predictable against surprising. Same scores, different dice.
